rationale: Tests application of the four prima facie principles in an Indian clinical scenario after the principles section
Tests understanding of the Samira Kohli v. Prabha Manchanda (2008) landmark consent ruling after the applied clinical ethics section
Tests correct documentation practice including medico-legal significance after the documentation standards section
Tests understanding of systems-based risk management and error disclosure obligations after the risk management section
Tests analysis of appropriate vs. inappropriate use of information technology in clinical practice after the IT in clinical practice section
Tests understanding of the PICO framework and evidence appraisal as components of lifelong learning after the evidence appraisal section
Tests ability to apply awareness of clinical limits in a realistic on-call scenario after the section on recognising and acting on clinical limits
Tests understanding of the mentoring relationship and its ethical boundaries after the professional networks and mentoring section

Tests application of ICMR research consent rules for illiterate participants after the vulnerable populations and special consent section
